analysis.title: Early views on key state election results for power and utilities
key_insights: GS focuses on Texas, Georgia, Ohio and California state elections because of their implications for data center development, pace of power demand, pricing, utility investment and wildfire liability reform.

Consistent with GS Macro's post-election views, Democratic wins could increase near-term uncertainty around data center development, particularly in Texas and Georgia. GS still sees these markets as important longer-term areas for load growth.
The Texas gubernatorial outcome could drive negative reactions in exposed stocks: Buy rated VST, NRG, SRE and XEL, and Neutral rated CEG and AEP.
In Georgia, the PSC election outcome could be negative for Neutral rated SO.
In Ohio, the gubernatorial outcome could be less constructive for Buy rated FE and Neutral rated AEP, with more limited impact on Buy rated DUK.

In California, GS awaits clarity on a potential special legislative session before November 15th. If called, and depending on the outcome, it might be positive for Buy rated PCG and SRE and Neutral rated EIX.
The note covers state election results only. GS recognizes that federal results may also have implications.
